notes.title: Japanese and Vietnamese Translation Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a while.

Quite late, but we've reached 100 reviews! Thank you all for the support for PrinHero!

As the title says, we've added Japanese subtitles with the help of Akira Mahogany, and Vietnamese subtitles thanks to Nhung Tran who also worked on Trapped with Jester's Vietnamese translations. 

Special thanks to place_b as well for proofreading and testing the Japanese version!

To access the language options, go to settings > then pick the language of your choice.

notes.title: Russian Translation Update
notes.content:
Hi all!

We're almost to 50 reviews, thank you all for the support for PrinHero! 

As the title says, we've added a Russian Translation update thanks to Viktor Licht~

To access the language, go to settings > then pick the language of your choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184024/e82b333d3170c10fd3ed8cba89fc91db693c83d0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184024/19ae754470ea8363635c74fc096c55f67920e4fd.png

As for Reo Route...

Yes, I've been reading your reviews and I'm glad you all like our resident butler! 

Unfortunately, his route couldn't be made *yet*, which is to say, yes, there is a possibility for his route to be made. And if his route were ever to be made, it would be a serious route, not a joke route- so it would take time and resources to make, both of which I cannot afford right now.

If his route is to ever enter development, we'll make an announcement!
